notes: Company is Quince (quince.com); scoped strictly to the Home department per task instructions. Checked for a Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance/End of Line concept: (1) homepage + /shop/home department page nav and mega-menus - no Clearance/Sale/Outlet nav item anywhere; (2) full embedded __NEXT_DATA__ nav tree for the entire site (all department mega-menus) searched for slugs containing 'sale', 'clearance', 'outlet', 'final-sale', 'last-chance', 'discontinued' - zero hits under any department, including Home; (3) sitemap.xml -> sitemap_us.xml -> sitemap_shop.xml/sitemap_misc.xml/sitemap_subcollections.xml (the full canonical URL list for the site) - grepped case-insensitively for sale/clearance/outlet - zero hits in any of the four sitemap files; (4) direct URL probing of plausible paths (/shop/home/sale, /shop/home/clearance, /shop/home/outlet, /shop/home/final-sale, /shop/home/last-chance, /shop/sale, /shop/clearance, /shop/outlet, /clearance) - all returned HTTP 404; (5) the bare vanity path /sale returned an HTTP 308 redirect (via an old email-marketing UTM link, campaign name 'insiderSalePreview') to /insider-sale, which itself redirects to /shop/insider-sale (HTTP 200, page titled 'EVERYDAY STEALS'). This page IS a real PLP (FILTER_AND_SORT + PRODUCT_LIST widgets, 204 total rows per its own count) but it is NOT a Home-scoped listing: it is not linked from the homepage, the Home department page, or any mega-menu (confirmed absent from the full nav JSON and from a full-text search of the homepage HTML) - it is only reachable via the legacy /sale redirect or by guessing /shop/insider-sale directly. Its own Category/Department filter facets list Women/Men/Kids & Baby/Home/Apparel/Bags/Beauty/etc., and a sample of the first 30 product rows returned mostly apparel (sweaters, cardigans, dresses, tees, pajamas), one bag, one beauty item, and only 2 Home items (a duvet insert, a pillow) - i.e. a storewide mixed-department markdown page, not a Home-specific Clearance/Outlet listing. Attempted to isolate the Home-only subset via its own 'departments=Home' filter facet using several plausible query-string shapes (?departments=Home, ?department=Home, ?filter.departments=Home, ?departments[]=Home) - none changed the server-rendered total or filter-selected state, indicating the filter is applied client-side via a JS-driven request rather than a URL param honored by SSR; isolating a verified Home-only count would require Playwright/CDP interaction with the filter UI. Given this page (a) is not Home-scoped in the site's own navigation/taxonomy, (b) is dominated by non-Home departments, and (c) the task instructions explicitly scope this project to Quince's Home range and not apparel, it is excluded here rather than force-fit as a 'Home Clearance' row. No genuine Home-scoped Clearance/Outlet/Final-Sale PLP exists on quince.com as of this check.
